Learn moreOnline multiplayer on console requires eligible Game Pass plan.DETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionPre-order any edition of Rayman Legends Retold and receive the exclusive Hoodlum Havoc Pack, containing 2 costumes for Rayman and Globox inspired by Rayman 3: Hoodlum Havoc. Includes: the base game + Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition. Embark on a bold reimagining of the acclaimed platformer, filled with new content and narrative twists. When a shadowy villain spreads corruption across the Glade of Dreams, journey through its charming worlds solo or in up to 4‑player couch co‑op in a fast‑paced, side‑scrolling adventure where every stumble and surprise adds to the delightful chaos. PURE PLATFORMING JOY Leap, glide, and punch your way through worlds bursting with charm and delightful surprises. Craving a change of pace? Dive into unforgettable musical stages, where every move must sync with the beat for a rhythm‑powered thrill. NEW AND IMPROVED GAMEPLAY Immerse yourself in a world brimming with life, reimagined with stunning visuals. A rich selection of iconic levels returns alongside a mysterious sixth realm and 4 new musical stages. Saddle up for epic dragon rides and test your skills in the Cave of Trials. A FRESH TAKE ON AN EPIC TALE Join Rayman and his friends on their most ambitious adventure yet, facing a new foe stirring trouble from the underworld. Voiced cinematics and an expanded soundtrack by Christophe Héral and Grant Kirkhope bring the journey to life, blending original themes with new compositions. 4 PLAYERS, LEGENDARY FUN Play the entire adventure in up to 4-player couch co-op, racing for Lums or knocking each other off to claim every last Teensy. Kung Foot also returns with improved controls, power-ups, and customizable rules for hours of frantic competition. INCLUDES RAYMAN ORIGINS: ENHANCED EDITION (Re)discover the platforming classic, now featuring 4K visuals, new collectibles and rewards, plus a range of quality-of-life improvements. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionAeterna Lucis is our purest metroidvania yet, and the sequel Aeterna Noctis fans have been waiting for. Step into the role of the Queen of Light, explore a vast interconnected world, awaken new powers and push further and further in a hand-drawn adventure crafted with the stained-glass art of the Aeterna Universe. New to the saga? Start here. Aeterna Lucis is the sequel to Aeterna Noctis and continues its story, but it can be your first game in the Aeterna Universe. And if you fall in love with it, play Aeterna Noctis afterwards to uncover many more details of the story. For the first time, two ways to experience Aeterna: • Aeterna Mode · Pure Metroidvania: a balanced experience between exploration and combat, perfect for adventure lovers. Recommended for most players and for discovering Aeterna Lucis for the first time. • Lucis Mode · NoctisVania: far more intense platforming challenges and relentless bosses. Designed for hardcore players, or for a second adventure after Aeterna Mode. A WORLD TO EXPLORE Golden cities suspended among the clouds, jungles that awaken at night, forgotten temples, caves of sand and rock, and depths bathed in light. A huge interconnected map, full of secrets, alternative routes and side quests, that invites you to get lost and come back stronger. • A vast, connected world: every region has its own identity, its own inhabitants and its own dangers. • Secrets everywhere: hidden paths, optional challenges and rewards for those who explore every corner. • Allies and quests: gather support to stop the collapse of Aeterna. POWERS THAT TAKE YOU FURTHER The Queen of Light moves with an agility never seen before in the saga. Awaken brand-new abilities, combine them at your own pace and discover how far you can go. • Precise movement: dash, jumps and traversal with far more polished controls. • New abilities: offensive and passive powers that expand the way you explore and fight. AGILE COMBAT, EPIC BOSSES An agile combat system, weapons exclusive to the Queen of Light and final bosses that are a visual, sonic and gameplay spectacle. THE ART OF AETERNA Stained-glass art and hand-drawn detail in every setting, every enemy and every character. The entire Aeterna Universe pulses with a single style, accompanied by a soundtrack that ranges from the most epic to the most serene. LIGHT AGAINST CHAOS After the ending of Aeterna Noctis, the balance between Light and Darkness has been broken. The Queen of Light awakens alone in a world on the brink of the abyss and must challenge the Supreme God Chaos to uncover the truth about the curse of the two monarchs. Dialogues, item descriptions and environmental storytelling enrich the story without ever slowing your progress.
